programme.title: Pretres
programme.desc: Otkad postoji šou-biznis na brdovitom Balkanu, zvezde se trude da kupe našu pažnju. Jedni se vole, drugi mrze, treći raskidaju, neki nam pričaju o velikim ljubavima i slomljenim srcima za pet minuta slave i po neku naslovnu stranu, a onda se nadaju da nismo čitali novine ili još bolje, da smo zaboravili kako su nekada izgledali i šta su pričali. Emisija "Pretres" okrenuće naglavačke nečiju karijeru i podsetiti nas na ono što je ta osoba bila nekad, i pokazati nam šta je postala danas.

programme.title: Klan
programme.desc: Ubistvo velikog mafijaškog bosa, odrazilo se na celo podzemlje. Svi bi hteli da zauzmu njegovo mesto. Dvojica provincijalaca, brzo napreduju na mafijaškoj lestvici i uspostavljaju novi poslovni model. Šok i Paša uspostavljajući taj model, u svoje poslove upliću sve oko sebe.

programme.title: Aviondžije
programme.desc: Sitkom koji prati urnebesne avanture buntovnih stjuarta i pilota, pod nazivom Aviondžije, u režiji Aleksandra Savića i Dušana Popovića, prva je serija Hype production doo. Svaka epizoda prati let u neki novi grad na kojem se posada susreće sa novim neobičnim putnicima i najrazličitijim peripetijama i opasnostima koje život među oblacima donosi. Kroz brojne doživljaje na različitim krajevima sveta naši junaci pokazuju i svoje drugo lice. Član posade Macan se zaljubljuje u devojku kojoj se najmanje nadao, stjuardesa Nina pronalazi svog milionera samo da bi se zapitala da li je on taj koji će je usrećiti, a najzaljubljeniji članovi posade Dana i Mile prolaze sve turbulencije svoje tajne ljubavi da bi ih na kraju puta dočekalo neočekivano razrešenje.

programme.title: Ko si kad ne gleda niko
programme.desc: Ko si kad ne gleda niko, autora i voditelja Galiba Gicića, donosi razgovore sa najuspešnijim ljudima iz sveta politike, sporta, glume, muzike, biznisa i vere. Kroz aktuelne teme i sećanja, otkrivamo njihovu priču iz drugačijeg ugla. Razgovaramo i o temama o kojima drugi ne žele ili ne smeju da pričaju. Dok prikazujemo sva važna mesta koja su obeležila njihove živote i karijere. Uz aktuelnu temu i lične priče, serijal često promoviše istorijske znamenitosti gradova u kojima se snima.

programme.title: Pad u raj
programme.desc: Komedija o avanturama kralja srbijanskog crnog tržišta, njegove obitelji i američkog navigatora kojeg su srušili i zarobili za vrijeme NATO-ovog bombardiranja 1999. U centru radnje je Ljubiša Kundačina (Lazar Ristovski), mladić kojeg izluđuje američki embargo, njegova vlada, bombardiranje i _ susjedov pas. Kap koja je prelila čašu bila je njegova sestra koja je svakodnevno pozirala neprijateljskim pilotima. Ljubiša odlučuje poduzeti nešto te uz pomoć rumunjskog krijumčarskog lanca nabavlja rusku raketu kojom uspjeva srušiti američki avion AWACS. Zarobljava pilota (Simon Lyndon) koji pokušava pobjeći što mu nikako ne uspijeva. Nevjerovatno, ali istinito, to je tek početak zapleta do čijeg vrhunca dolaza kada pilot Ljubiši ponudi 5 mil. USD ukoliko mu pomogne uhvatiti Slobodana Miloševića.

programme.title: Leto bez mrlje
programme.desc: "Leto bez mrlje" je humoristična serija u formi sitcoma s elementima telenovele, smeštena na otok Rab, koji svojom lepotom i šarmom postaje neizostavan lik ove tople, duhovite i vizuelno atraktivne priče. Radnja prati brata i sestru – Beograđane Luku i Anđelu – kojima je njihova ekscentrična baka obećala u nasleđe ostaviti kuću na Rabu. No, uslov je jednostavan samo na papiru: tokom celog leta moraju kuću uspešno iznajmljivati turistima bez ijedne negativne recenzije. U praksi, to znači svakodnevno suočavanje s nizom nepredvidivih gostiju, kulturoloških razlika, ljubavnih zavrzlama, tajni, podvala i urnebesnih nesporazuma. Uz sve to, tu je i bakina dodatna "ostavština" – strogi butler Stipe koji je s kućom došao kao bonus i čija prisutnost unosi dodatnu napetost i zabavu u svakodnevicu mladih domaćina.

programme.title: Rikošet
programme.desc: Rikošet je oddaja, ki se neposredno poglobi v zgodbe črne kronike, na kraje, kjer so se dogodki zares zgodili. S terenskimi reportažami in avtentičnimi posnetki s kraja dogodka se vračamo k primerom, ki so pritegnili pozornost javnosti, beležimo vzdušje, sledi zgodb in pričevanja ljudi, ki so bili blizu dogajanju. Spremljamo aktualne primere, hkrati pa se vračamo tudi k zločinom, ki so ostali globoko zapisani v javnem spominu. Rikošet prinaša kratke intervjuje, analize, dokumentiranje primerov in dokumentarne rekonstrukcije najhujših zločinov, z namenom, da je vsaka zgodba predstavljena čim bolj celovito in verodostojno. Ne prinašamo le novice o tem, kaj se je zgodilo – odpravimo se na kraj dogodka, zabeležimo zgodbo in ohranimo zapis o primerih, ki so zaznamovali črno kroniko.

programme.title: Odlazak po Kodi
programme.desc: Radnja filma smeštena je u ozloglašenom delu Vankuvera, gde živi Art Frankel, varalica i besposličar, koji je do ušiju zaljubljen u atraktivnu Kodi Veson. Kada ona zapadne u komu usled očiglednog predoziranja, Art se odlučuje da potraži jedinu osobu koja mu nudi bilo kakvu nadu: svog prijatelja Harvija, beskućnika s vremenskom mašinom pronađenom u kontejneru za otpad. Očajnički želeći da dopre do Kodi, Art potiskuje svoju nevericu i upušta se u putovanje kroz vreme i prostor, duboko u Kodinu prošlost. Nakon nekoliko ponižavajućih pokušaja da shvati gde su stvari krenule naopako, polako počinje da uviđa da bi njen stvarni problem u životu mogao biti upravo on. Ono što sledi jeste niz nepromišljenih pokušaja da izbegne ono čega se najviše boji _ žrtvovanje svoje istinske ljubavi prema Kodi u zamenu za njen život.

programme.desc: Svaki mašinovođa, tokom svoje profesionalne karijere, nenamerno ubije 20 _ 30 ljudi. Žrtve su obično samoubice, nepažljivi, pijani, ili samo odsutni ljudi. Ovo je tragična komedija o nevinim ubicama i njihovim životima. Ilija je šezdesetogodišnji mašinovođa, na korak do penzije. On drži neslavan rekord od 28 gaženja tokom karijere. Njegov devetnaestogodišnji usvojeni sin Sima priprema se da nastavi porodičnu tradiciju. Ilija ga upoznaje sa poslom i činjenicom da su nesreće neizbežne. Sima se plaši, on ne želi da postane ubica. Najviše ga zanima koliko će vremena proći dok mu se ne desi prvo gaženje.

programme.title: Leto bez mrlje
programme.desc: "Leto bez mrlje" je humoristična serija u formi sitcoma s elementima telenovele, smeštena na otok Rab, koji svojom lepotom i šarmom postaje neizostavan lik ove tople, duhovite i vizuelno atraktivne priče. Radnja prati brata i sestru – Beograđane Luku i Anđelu – kojima je njihova ekscentrična baka obećala u nasleđe ostaviti kuću na Rabu. No, uslov je jednostavan samo na papiru: tokom celog leta moraju kuću uspešno iznajmljivati turistima bez ijedne negativne recenzije. U praksi, to znači svakodnevno suočavanje s nizom nepredvidivih gostiju, kulturoloških razlika, ljubavnih zavrzlama, tajni, podvala i urnebesnih nesporazuma. Uz sve to, tu je i bakina dodatna "ostavština" – strogi butler Stipe koji je s kućom došao kao bonus i čija prisutnost unosi dodatnu napetost i zabavu u svakodnevicu mladih domaćina.

programme.desc: Zanatlije, donosi priče o starim zanatima koji i danas žive, često daleko od očiju javnosti. Serijal otkriva ljude koji čuvaju veštine prenošene generacijama i pokazuje kako ti zanati opstaju u savremenom vremenu. U fokusu su rad, znanje i posvećenost koji stoje iza svakog proizvoda nastalog na tradicionalan način.

programme.title: Rikošet
programme.desc: Rikošet je oddaja, ki se neposredno poglobi v zgodbe črne kronike, na kraje, kjer so se dogodki zares zgodili. S terenskimi reportažami in avtentičnimi posnetki s kraja dogodka se vračamo k primerom, ki so pritegnili pozornost javnosti, beležimo vzdušje, sledi zgodb in pričevanja ljudi, ki so bili blizu dogajanju. Spremljamo aktualne primere, hkrati pa se vračamo tudi k zločinom, ki so ostali globoko zapisani v javnem spominu. Rikošet prinaša kratke intervjuje, analize, dokumentiranje primerov in dokumentarne rekonstrukcije najhujših zločinov, z namenom, da je vsaka zgodba predstavljena čim bolj celovito in verodostojno. Ne prinašamo le novice o tem, kaj se je zgodilo – odpravimo se na kraj dogodka, zabeležimo zgodbo in ohranimo zapis o primerih, ki so zaznamovali črno kroniko.

programme.title: Srce na terenu
programme.desc: Ali Meš ima 16 godina, srednjoškolka je iz San Dijega, i broj jedan na američkoj teniskoj juniorskoj listi. Živi između pažljivo kontrolisanih graničnih linija juniorskog tenisa, neporažena je i sprema se da uđe u vode profesionalnog tenisa. Zbog opsesivnog oca-trenera nikada nije imala normalan život, ali stvari se menjaju kada se povredi igrajući protiv žestoke konkurentkinje iz Rusije. Prinuđena da bude van terena, izbegava očeve rehabilitacione treninge i počinje i sama da trenira nižerangiranog igrača Farela Gemblsa, dok istovremeno otkriva normalan tinejdžerski život u šta spada i zaljubljivanje. Paralelno, sprema se za revanš-meč s ruskom rivalkom kojoj hoće da pokaže šta je potrebno imati da bi se pobedilo na terenu, ali i kako se živi van njega.

programme.title: Spirit
programme.desc: A recently bereved father takes his daughter to a new town only to find that their new Victorian house appears to be haunted.

programme.title: Train Master
programme.desc: 62 year old Jeremiah Wilson is truly the Train Master of Willamette Western Railroad. He lives, breaths, and eats railroad. When Brett Banner, 32 year old heir to New York Eastern talks his dad into purchasing Willamette Western, there is immediately a clash between himself and Jeremiah. Jeremiah is fired by Brett two years from retirement and turns into a angry, depressed grandfather. When Brett's nine year old son Justin realizes Jeremiah's grandson Thomas can drive a locomotive, he kidnaps and holds Thomas' favorite dinosaur ransom. Justin, Thomas and 3 other children board an old engine in for repairs and accidentally turns it into runaway engine causing a chain reaction of events.

programme.title: No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Sharon Maguire's Oscar-nominated romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Colin Firth and Hugh Grant. As a New Year's Resolution, a British woman seeks to improve her mundane life and decides to go in search of her perfect companion before having a fling with her boss, keeping a diary of her actions along the way. Celia Imrie is among the co-stars.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Shaka Zulu: The Citadel
programme.desc: Prentice Mungo (David Hasselhoff) is a slave-trader who discovers that his ship is carrying a stowaway, Katherine (Karen Allen). Katherine is seeking passage to Africa to see her father, a British officer stationed there. But when they arrive, Mungo discovers Shaka, king of the Zulu tribe, among the slaves he is going to be transporting. Using his cleverness and leadership abilities, Zulu incites the slaves to revolt, and takes Katherine captive as he flees into the African countryside.

programme.title: Time Out of Mind
programme.desc: Oren Moverman's drama Time out of Mind stars Richard Gere as George, a homeless, mentally-ill man who has been unable to hold a job for years. He drifts through the city looking for food, alcohol, and shelter. He also tries to make contact with his estranged daughter (Jena Malone). Eventually George takes advantage of some of the social services provided by the city of New York, but he lacks the proper paperwork to get the financial assistance he needs. He befriends a fellow homeless man (Ben Vereen) who claims to have been a successful jazz musician. Time Out of Mind screened at the 2014 Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: Beeban Kidron's romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth. Bridget is questioning her romance with Mark Darcy when her sneaky boss Daniel returns, and the possibility of an exotic holiday gives her a chance to run away from it all.

programme.title: Uzmi moje pare i trči
programme.desc: Serija prati fascinantan život "kriptokraljice" _ Ruje Ignatove.

programme.title: Zavejani
programme.desc: Nakon užasne veze za jednu noć, dvoje stranaca bude se zavejani, nakon mećave koja je u led okovala čitav Menhetn. Sada su zarobljeni u malenom stanu, primorani da upoznaju jedno drugo mnogo bolje nego što je to običaj kod veza za jednu noć.

programme.desc: Predsednik jedne afričke zemlje izjavljuje da će budžet za naoružavanje pretvoriti u budžet za navodnjavanje. Novinar Majkl Pauer ubrzo saznaje da trgovci oružjem pripremaju puč.

programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica, koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora prisiljava na zatvaranje posla. Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi

programme.title: Draga Elizabet
programme.desc: Muškarac koji vodi dosadan život slučajno počinje da proganja staru koleginicu s fakulteta, glumicu Elizabet Benks, na društvenim mrežama. U svojim pokušajima da dokaže da je poznaje, ponovo otkriva sebe i pravo značenje prijateljstva.

programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Sumnja
programme.desc: Darel Džejkobs je penzionisani mafijaš koji živi u Finiksu. Kad oboli od raka, shvata da mu vreme ističe, pa svakodnevno posećuje svoj omiljeni kafe. Mlada kelnerica, Ališa Foret, studentkinja prava, zaintrigirana je tajanstvenim redovnim posetiocem, pa ga prati do kuće. Ubrzo započinje prijateljstvo koje Ališu dovodi u opasnost i primorava Darela da dovrši "nesvršena posla". Ališin momak, Tom, ne odobrava njihovo prijateljstvo, pa ih prati. Kad otkrije Darelov pravi identitet, Tom upada u paniku, ali ne zbog bezbednosti svoje devojke. Već zbog svoje.

programme.desc: Advokatica opsednuta poslom primorana je da iz temelja promeni svoj život nakon što je suprug iznenada napusti.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre "Kralj ratnika".

programme.title: Ukradena dolina
programme.desc: Da bi spasila život svojoj majci, meksičko-navaho mehaničarka udružuje snage s odmetnicom kako bi se suprotstavile korumpiranom zemljoposedniku.

programme.title: Uhvati me za ruku
programme.desc: Majka troje dece, koja živi u Londonu i nalazi se na vrhuncu karijere, saznaje da boluje od multiple skleroze. Nakon iznenadne smrti supruga i gubitka posla, vraća se u rodnu Australiju, gde slučajan susret sa srednjoškolskom ljubavi budi novu nadu u ljubav dok vodi tešku borbu sa bolešću.

programme.title: Poslednja stvar
programme.desc: Dilan Derindžer, usamljeni stomatolog sa Floride, suočava se s osobom iz prošlosti koja mu donosi vesti koje ga vode na uzbudljivo putovanje. Na ovom putovanju otkriće sebe i promeniti sopstveni život.

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Iz senke
programme.desc: Teri ima sjajan život, sjajnog dečka i upravo je dobila na lutriji, ali se ubrzo nakon toga budi u tamnici, gde je muči poludeli doktor, opsednut svojom novom drogom za silovanje, tražeći istovremeno njen dobitni tiket. Užas s kojim se susreće nije samo pred njom, već i u najmračnijim zabitima njenog uma.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Stranger Within a Woman
programme.desc: Two friends meet in a bar. Later that night, one friend's flirtatious wife is reportedly in an accident. The other friend doesn't feel well. What's come over him?

programme.title: The Parakeets
programme.desc: Lili, an ill young woman, is faced one morning with the sudden loss of her hair. The imagination of her friend Laura is going to change the course of a day, which had badly begun.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Due to a bet drunk Gene almost forces Majesty to marry him, then escapes after brawling with sheriff Tom. Majesty buys a ranch, needs Gene's help and finds him in a drunken stupor in Mexico. He vows to stay sober and fights crooked Tom.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: Santa Fe Marshall
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Hopalong Cassidy is called when a town becomes overrun with bad guys. Disguised as a member of a medicine show, Hoppy discovers that the ringleader is none other than sweet li'l ol' Ma Burton.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: Horse Tales
programme.desc: Horse Tales tells the story of stable boys, adolescents making a living by taking care of horses. In order to do so, it focuses on their job and their relationships with the animals they care for.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: Voyage to the Prehistoric Planet
programme.desc: In 2020, after the colonization of the moon, the spaceships Vega, Sirius and Capella are launched from Lunar Station 7.

programme.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
programme.desc: A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat
programme.desc: Lise, a mentally unbalanced middle-aged woman, travels from her home in Copenhagen to Rome, Italy where she embarks on a fatal destiny, a premeditated search for someone, anyone, with whom she can form a dangerous liaison.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
programme.desc: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: Joan of Arkansas
programme.desc: When the U.S. Space program requires an ordinary person to become the first human in space, the Saraback Computer chooses Joan Jones, a scatter brained, good natured klutz who works as a dental technician.

programme.title: Lukas the Strange
programme.desc: Lukas Nino (Lukas the Strange) follows an awkward teenager facing his initiation into manhood as a film crew descends on his village. After being told his father is a tikbalang—half horse, half man—Lukas begins to question his own nature when his father disappears. As the village is swept up in movie fever, a legend emerges about a mystical river that erases painful memories. Narrated by Lukas' friend Lorena, the film blends myth, coming-of-age, and imagination.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: A man in a gleaming white suit comes to a small Southern town on the eve of integration. He calls himself a social reformer. But what he does is stir up trouble--trouble he soon finds he can't control.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Father of the bride faces becoming a grandfather.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: Le locataire
programme.desc: Nicole's pregnancy test is conclusive: she is pregnant. At fifty-four, Nicole is anything but prepared for this discovery. Down-to-earth and pragmatic, not prone to despair or doubt, she usually strives to be the pillar of a family on which everyone ultimately depends. With her full-time job as a toll booth cashier, she manages to feed her little world and keep the house running. But this news shakes the family a little.

programme.title: AUN: The Beginning and the End of All Things
programme.desc: When looking for alternative energy sources, the Japanese scientist Sekai tragically dies. Twenty years later the Brazilian mathematician Euclides continues his research. The lack of an essential component won't allow a breakthrough. Only AUN, Sekai's son, seems to hold the key to protect mankind from self-destruction. In the aftermath of the nuclear tragedy in Fukushima the film appears like a prophecy. AUN's dream-like images, complemented by music from Christian Fennesz and Ryuichi Sakamoto, lead into a fantastic and exciting world, full of brightness and darkness of life.

programme.title: Dead Men Walk
programme.desc: The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.

programme.title: Hantise
programme.desc: After an accident, Agnes wakes up, amnesiac. She is introduced to her husband, her child, her house, her job, her life. Or the one people wants to tell her?

programme.title: Dok nas smrt ne rastavi
programme.desc: Kris i Teresa izgledaju kao savršen par. Ali kada jedno od njih nestaje, nastaje petomesečni pakao sa šokantnim krajem.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Dr Ema Krejtorn i njen tim stručnjaka su na zadatku da reše složene probleme s kožom. Oni pomažu ljudima čiji su životi sputani traumatičnim poremećajima.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Dr Sandra Li nije samo jedan od vodećih dermatologa u Americi. Na Jutjubu, ona je poznata kao dr Pimpl Poper koja je na svom kanalu izvela hiljade procedura.

programme.desc: Emisija govori o ljudima iz celog sveta koji pate od retkih i misterioznih medicinskih stanja. Nekima su potrebne toliko složene operacije da su šanse za preživljavanje minimalne.

programme.desc: Nikitin otac ima rak i strahuje da neće doživeti da prisustvuje njenom venčanju na Kipru. Uspevši da prebrodi mentalne probleme, Loren je u potrazi za savršenom haljinom.

programme.title: Salon za neveste sa oblinama

programme.desc: Mišel pokušava da smrša kako bi ušla u venčanicu koju je kupila prošle godine. Nevesta Ališa nije videla svoju majku i baku godinu dana.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Pratimo živote 12 ljudi, od kojih je svako težak oko 300 kg. Tokom svog jednogodišnjeg putovanja oni pokušavaju da izgube, svi zajedno, stotine kilograma, da bi ostali u životu.

programme.title: Dvostruki životi žena iz predgrađa
programme.desc: Na prvi pogled, one su supruge, majke i komšinice iz predgrađa, ali to je samo pola priče. Iza zatvorenih vrata, ovih šest žena iz Sent Luisa u tajnosti zarađuje kreirajući provokativan sadržaj.

programme.title: Bejlin želi da je čuju
programme.desc: Serija nastavlja da prati Bejlin Dipri, energičnu i hrabru mladu ženu koja živi sa Turetovim sindromom, dok se suočava sa izazovima života, ljubavi i samostalnosti. Zahvaljujući svojoj iskrenosti, zaraznom humoru i nepokolebljivom duhu, Bejlin je postala uzor mnogima, nudeći osvežavajuću i autentičnu sliku o životu sa stvarnim izazovima.

programme.title: Kim Kardašijan: Krađa dijamanata
programme.desc: Kim Kardašijan je opljačkana uz pretnju oružjem _ ukraden je nakit vredan 6 miliona dolara, a za parisku elitnu brigadu ugled grada je u pitanju.

programme.title: Stopala me ubijaju
programme.desc: Dr Bred uklanja izrasline poput rogova na ženskim stopalima. Pored toga, dr Eboni pomaže ženi koja nije videla svoje stopalo skoro dve godine.

programme.title: Dok nas smrt ne rastavi
programme.desc: Ubistvo je, kao i prava ljubav, zapisano u zvezdama. Detektivi, porodica i prijatelji podsećaju se slučajeva veza koje su se završile ubistvom.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Dejvid je u poseti dr Emi zbog velike izrasline na leđima koja naglo raste. A, Arijina promena pola iz muškog u ženski je unazađena jer joj na licu raste brada.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Sari je zbog teške rozacee lice tako crveno da joj je suviše neprijatno da izlazi napolje. I još, dr. Ema koristi naprednu tehnologiju da bi uklonila tumor sa Trejsilininog nosa.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg: Brazil
programme.desc: Muškarci i žene koji učestvuju u ovoj emisiji imaju najmanje 270 kilograma. Ekipa ovog dokumentarnog serijala ih prati dok pokušavaju da dovedu liniju u red i tako promene svoj život.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Posle pet godina u kolicima, Latonjina težina učinila ju je gotovo nepokretnom. Ona ne želi da se odrekne hrane, ali hoće li to učiniti zbog ljubavi?

programme.title: Stopala me ubijaju
programme.desc: Posle 25 neuspešnih operacija, žena očajnički traži pomoć sa iskrivljenim nožnim prstima. Dr Bred pregleda džinovski žulj, a pacijentkinja dr Sare ima izbočine na stopalima.

programme.title: Animal Doctors
programme.desc: Explore how animals developed over time and generations their own medicine and health care strategies. How have these been passed onto early humans ? Questioning traditional boundaries between human and animal, we will travel from Central African Republic, to Tanzania, from the US to France with the leading experts in animal behaviour. Today's science revisits the birth of animal intelligence and culture.

programme.title: In the Darkness
programme.desc: An immersion in the heart of the biggest West-African prison: Abidjan. Located out of sight at the border of the Banco forest, this prison host 5,000 inmates but has capacity for 1,500. With the inmates' help, life inside is organized, and a degree of stability exists.

programme.title: In the Sea
programme.desc: About 71% of our planet's surface is covered by water, and about 97% of it is in the oceans. The sea also produces most of the oxygen we breathe. Thus, stimulating conservation and learning about also produces most of the oxygen we breathe. Thus, stimulating conservation and learning about the marine environment is fundamental to our very existence. This series follows scientists who work in five projects in the Petrobras Socio-environmental Program.

programme.title: Baccarat, the Crystal Legend
programme.desc: This film retraces 250 years of French art de vivre from Royal Courts to today's finest Crystal works found in the most prestigious settings commissioned by leading figures and celebrities. The saga started in Lorraine a region known for its tradition in glassmaking where the manufacture shaped its unrivaled know-how and created its iconic pieces. Today, to shape its brand into the XXIst century with intact splendor and craft, the world's most celebrated crystal maker has developed fruitful collaboration with international designers, such as Philippe Starck.

programme.title: Mefloquine
programme.desc: Developed by the US Army after Vietnam to combat malaria in troops, Mefloquine became available to the public in the 90s. However, in the following decades it became most well-known for reports of its serious psychiatric side effects. Questions about why it has been so widely and easily dispensed have been raised for some time. The director's personal investigation seeks to understand why those affected have been left in the dark for so long. In doing so he uncovers some surprising truths about the powerful players involved in this controversial drug's story.

programme.title: The Leopard's New Spots
programme.desc: The Leopard's New Spots is a documentary film about one man's mission to halt the alarming decline in southern Africa's leopard populations due to a widespread skin trade. Traditionally, only the Zulu royals have been allowed to wear leopard skins. However, in the last three decades the Shembe Church, a four million strong religious group, has adopted the skins into their ceremonial costume. The demand for leopard skins is now astronomical. Because the use of skins is so wide spread and culturally entrenched, law enforcement seems helpless to police this trade in a protected species. It has become, in one researchers words, 'a major conservation blind spot'. Leopard researcher Tristan Dickerson believes that you can't save the leopard without the support of the Shembe people. The film follows Dickerson as he travels from the heart of leopard country to the heart of Shembe and Zulu culture in an effort to discover a solution that benefits all parties. His best solution turns out to be fake fur. Bad fakes are commonly used by church members while they save for the expensive real thing. Dickerson believes that if he can produce a high quality, affordable fake fur, and gain the endorse

programme.title: Life in the Blue
programme.desc: This film uncovers the rich diversity of life in the open ocean, where survival happens in a 10-meter band beneath the surface. Contrary to popular belief, these vast blue waters teem with species—from barracuda spiraling in defense to blue sharks crossing 4,000 km of Atlantic waters. Dolphins hunt schools of fish, while turtles, pilot whales, and whale sharks undertake epic migrations. Even shipwrecks become vibrant oases, colonized by corals and fish. In this harsh, shelterless world, only the most adaptable survive.

programme.title: The Boy From the Wild
programme.desc: Growing up on a Game Reserve meant to help wildlife get out of captivity, it shares how it began & how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments in the wild.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We travel to the end of the rainbow in Dublin, Ireland. We'll gawk at the Book of Kells, a holy book displayed at Trinity College. We visited the hallowed halls of St. Patrick's Cathedral, and touched famed Irishman, Daniel O'Connell's crypt at Glasnevin Cemetery. Finally, we learn the complicated history of Irish independence at Kilmainham jail.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your sun tan lotion on, because we're headed to the land of perfect weather and sunsets. We'll sample a fish taco, climb the 100's of steps of the California Tower, stand on the flight deck of the USS Midway, as well as, revisit San Diego's founding on the San Salvador at the San Diego Maritime museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Chasing down Albacore Tuna 65 miles off West Coast Vancouver Island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

The most significant building to people of the Sikh faith, it is open to people of all faiths. We witness the celebration of the changing of the guard before heading into the mountains for a visit to the British influenced town of Shimla. Journeys then heads further north for look at the resort area of Manali.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The people and wildlife of the western state of Gujarat have found ways to survive in an inhospitable environment. Unique big game exists side-by-side with some of the most talented and unique craftsman in the world. Bill gets the inside scoop on this strange land and is doubly surprised by his local guide.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: If there ever was a lost wildlife gem, it would be Mikumi. Here many of the Big Twelve live their lives against the backdrop of one of the most scenic parks in Africa. Bill takes a break from the wildlife safari to investigate the huge salt works at the edge of the park and how it may impact future conservation.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: South Africa has many different tribal groups and ethnic people, but none have a more fascinating story than the Zulu. These were once the most feared warriors in all of Africa and they have fiercely held onto that culture. They're also dedicated conservationists and we see first-hand the wildlife sanctuaries they've created. This is a proud people with a unique history, and we get to share that with them.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.desc: Fashion designer Ji Cheng has shown her designs at London fashion week and, like beauty stylist A Zhi, is beginning to challenge the monopoly of Western brands in China. New levels of expendable income mean the wallets of the wealthy elite are helping fund this rising beauty scene and creating a market for luxury goods for shrewd businesswoman Felicity Feng. Expats from everywhere are trying to gain a foothold in this blossoming city, but can they handle its lightning speed?

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Forty years after the end of the conflict, unexploded bombs, secret tunnels and other vestiges of the long combat still exist in Vietnam.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The Waiting is the hardest part. The anticipation of the next face shot, of an uncut heli run, and of an approaching storm is enough to drive this group of skiers to devote their entire lives to the pursuit of a sport and a lifestyle.

programme.title: Paris - Berlin: Shapes and Shades of History
programme.desc: Paris and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: "D-DAY" _ June 6th 1944: Normandy landings Personal and daily items such as helmets, badges, bullets, weapons, cans have been uncovered by recent archeological digs. These traces left behind by soldiers and civilians on the battle ground and findings of underground passages and blockhouses kept secret provide new insights into 2WW History.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: On May 28, 1940, the Wehrmacht crushed the Allied armies in France. The British prepared for a deal with Hitler, even considering mediation through Mussolini. Left alone in the war cabinet, Churchill, with his cunning and will, finally persuaded his associates to go to war.

After that, we go underneath the city at the Pointe a Calliere archaeology museum. Next, we'll learn about the native ecosystem at the gigantic, indoor, BioDome. Lastly, we'll learn about the 1967 Montreal Expo at the structures that are still visited today.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This episode we visit the bright lights of Vancouver, Canada. We'll swing along the famous Capilano Suspension Bridge, get tranquil in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Chinese garden, learn about Captain Vancouver at the Vancouver Maritime Museum, dig up Cesna Em "The City Before the City" at the Museum of Vancouver, and dive into the city's seedy underbelly at the Police Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India's most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. First, we tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal's construction. Bill takes us to a factory where we learn how the craft of stone inlay that adorns the Taj Mahal, is still made today. We continue on to Fatehpur Sikri, a former Mughal capital, which was created of red sandstone and displays the influence of its Hindu and Mughal roots. Finally, we meet with a man that is giving the wildlife of India a voice and sanctuary.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the most sacred places in India are featured in this fascinating episode. Bill first burst the myths surrounding the legendary Khajuraho and its intricately carved temples before heading to the Holy City of Varanasi. Varanasi, the Jerusalem or Mecca for Hindus with its deep connection to the Ganges River, is explored with an insider's perspective.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World—all other great wilderness areas are compared to this vast savannah. Wildlife numbers are awesome, but nothing like the numbers of the great migration. Journeys places you in the midst of this natural phenomenon where predator and prey are on a march for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Host Bill Ball begins the ascent of the highest mountain in Africa. Trouble almost immediately affects the team as the cameraman suffers from fatigue and altitude sickness. Just over halfway, the trip is in serious doubt as altitude, cold and wind force the team to evaluate their fitness to continue.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Pro mountain bikers take to the rocky mountain terrain of Mexico's Copper Canyon for the ride of their life.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: X games medalists take to the slopes of Haines, Alaska to experience the ultimate in heli-skiing; a challenge to even the best of the best.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where, in the past few years, diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan joins world-renown cave explorer Brian Kakuk to investigate the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world! The formations in this cave are simply stunning, and incredibly unique.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. But to find out, Jonathan has to brave some very cold water. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Lora i Stojan predstavljaju tri zanimljiva jela albanske kuhinje. Prvo na redu je "fergese", jelo koje podseća na bugarski miš-maš u kojem se koristi džigerica. Zatim sledi jednostavan hleb iz tiganja, i balkanska verzija trileće.

programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Primož putuje na ostrvo Kaprije u Jadranskom moru. Ostrvo se nalazi u arhipelagu Šibenika u srednjoj Dalmaciji. Ostrvo je okruženo kristalno bistrom vodom, koja nudi mnoge delikatese.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Priče iz kulinarske bašte
programme.desc: Markus Vering uživa u usporenom životu na svom imanju u Saseksu. Putovanje u Kent inspiriše Markusa da zasadi biljke sa orašastim plodovima na svojoj farmi, a zatim skuplja bobice sa grmova.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Priče iz kulinarske bašte
programme.desc: Markus Vering istražuje nove mogućnosti na svom imanju u Saseksu. Markus upoznaje različite vrste paradajza i unosi promene koje će mu pomoći da zaštiti patke od napada lisica.

programme.title: Malezija sa Džastin Skofild
programme.desc: Otisnite se na nezaboravno kulinarsko putovanje kroz Maleziju sa Džastin Skofild. Džastin prodire duboko u srce Malezije čija se živopisna kultura, zadivljujući predeli i primamljivi ukusi udružuju i stvaraju izuzetno kulinarsko iskustvo.

programme.title: Malezija sa Džastin Skofild
programme.desc: Otisnite se na nezaboravno kulinarsko putovanje kroz Maleziju sa Džastin Skofild. Džastin prodire duboko u srce Malezije čija se živopisna kultura, zadivljujući predeli i primamljivi ukusi udružuju i stvaraju izuzetno kulinarsko iskustvo.

programme.title: Džejmijevi ekonomični recepti
programme.desc: Džejmi sprema jagnjeću kolenicu i ostatke pretvara u marokanske pastile. Koristi i staro povrće i pravi panzanela salatu od starog hleba.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Akis vam želi dobrodošlicu u originalnoj emisiji punoj ukusa! U svakoj epizodi predstavlja vam dva recepta koji spajaju grčku i mediteransku kuhinju. Otkrijte autentične ukuse na putovanju koje će ispuniti vašu kuhinju aromama i dobrim vibracijama.

programme.title: Džejson Aterton: Kuhinja Dubaija
programme.desc: U Dubaiju, Džejson pravi najbolje brze obroke i hranu za poneti. Na meniju su ostrige sa ljutim azijskim prelivom i jednostavan kukuruz na roštilju sa čilijem i parmezanom. Pridružuje mu se Hatim Matar, koji pravi testo sa sirom i jagnjeće kobasice.

programme.title: Razotkrivanje Australije sa Sarom
programme.desc: Voditeljka Sara Lafontejn nastavlja svoju avanturu kroz Severnu Teritoriju Australije u udaljenom jezeru Žuta voda. Kasnije upoznaje vlasnika jedine kafane na Ostrvu koza.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan često se vraćaju starim knjigama recepata, gde pronalaze prava mala kulinarska blaga, kao što je paprikaš od bamija, pečene ćufte u mlečnom sosu i medenjaci od đumbira.

programme.title: Roštiljska turneja sa Primožem
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Primož odlazi u Sarajevo i u malo selo iznad njega, poznato pod imenom Vukova Luka. Primož kuva sa starim prijateljem ispred njegove bajkovite kuće u šumi Vukov Konak.

programme.title: Roštiljska turneja sa Primožem
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Primož putuje kroz Hercegovinu i obilazi Mostar i Počitelj, drevne gradove na obali Neretve. Tamo priprema sač. U selu Blace, gde se Neretva uliva u more, Primož pravi neobičan brudet.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvajte kao profesionalac
programme.desc: U ovoj seriji, nagrađivani kuvar Mark Morijarti poziva gledaoce da preispitaju način na koji kuvaju kod kuće. Svake nedelje, Mark bira mali, ali svestran skup sastojaka i pretvara ih u tri potpuno različita jela _ pametna, kreativna i prepuna ukusa.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvajte kao profesionalac

programme.title: Bliski istok: Gozba sa Šejnom Delijom
programme.desc: Bogata aroma sveže pečenog hleba i peciva probudiće glad kod svakog. Najveći simbol bliskoistočnog gostoprimstva jeste sveže pecivo. Šejn i njegov gost Hajkal Radži podeliće svoje najbolje recepte za testo i hleb.

programme.title: Bliski istok: Gozba sa Šejnom Delijom
programme.desc: Sporo kuvano meso najbolje utoljava glad. Uparite ga s bliskoistočnim začinima i dobili ste savršenu kombinaciju. U današnjoj epizodi Tom Sarafijan pridružuje se u kuhinji voditelju Šejnu Deliji kako bi spremili najbolju sporo kuvanu hranu.

programme.title: Džejmijevi ekonomični recepti
programme.desc: Džejmi sprema prelepu pečenu šunku iz lonca sa sosom od peršuna, i u isto vreme u rerni peče hokaido bundevu, koju pretvara u uvojak od bundeve i riže.

programme.title: Razotkrivanje Australije sa Sarom
programme.desc: Voditeljka Sara Lafontejn putuje u Zapadnu Australiju kako bi posetila udaljeni grad Brum. Ovaj grad je poznat po svojim farmama na kojima se uzgajaju biseri.

programme.title: Prijatno

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Grčki kuvar Akis vraća se sa 20 novih epizoda punih recepata. Svaka epizoda prikazuje jedno slano jelo i jedan slatkiš. Od omiljenih domaćih jela do dekadentnih deserta, Akis donosi opušten, vedar pristup, koji će ceniti i početnici i iskusni kuvari.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Priče iz kulinarske bašte
programme.desc: Markus Vering istražuje nove mogućnosti na svom imanju u Saseksu. Putuje na imanje "The Newt" kako bi upoznao vrhunskog pčelara i na farmi gradi novi dom za svoje svinje.
